The benefits of professional cleanings

Stop plaque in its tracks

Daily brushing helps, but only professional cleanings remove hardened plaque and tartar, protecting your teeth and gums long-term.

Freshen your breath

A deep clean removes bacteria that cause bad breath, leaving your mouth fresh, smooth, and healthy.

Stronger, healthier teeth

Routine exams catch early signs of decay, gum disease, and bite issues before they become bigger concerns.

Feel confident in your smile

Cleaner teeth look brighter and feel better, giving you a fresh boost of confidence after every visit.
FAQs

items.title: How long does a cleaning take?
items.html: Most Montrose dental cleaning and exam appointments take about 60 minutes, depending on your needs.

items.title: What if my gums bleed during a cleaning?
items.html: Mild bleeding is common, especially if it’s been a while since your last visit. Regular cleanings and daily flossing strengthen your gums over time.

items.title: Do kids need dental cleanings too?
items.html: Yes! Children benefit greatly from professional cleanings. We recommend their first visit around age one or when their first tooth appears.

items.title: Will I need X-rays at every visit?
items.html: Not always. We take digital x-rays based on your individual needs — typically once a year or as needed.

items.title: Can a dental exam detect other health issues?
items.html: Absolutely. Because your oral health is closely connected to your overall health, we can spot early signs of diabetes, vitamin deficiencies, airway issues, and even heart-related concerns.

items.title: What’s the best toothpaste to use?
items.html: A fluoride toothpaste is best for cavity prevention. If you have sensitivity, gum issues, or enamel wear, we’ll recommend a personalized option.

modules.html:
Your visit, step by step

  • Check-in & review: We update your medical history and talk through any questions or concerns.
  • X-rays (if needed): Digital imaging helps us see what’s happening below the surface.
  • Thorough exam: Dr. Amin or Dr. Shinta examines your teeth, gums, bite, and airway to identify any early issues.
  • Deep cleaning: Our hygienist gently removes plaque and tartar, then polishes your teeth for a smooth, clean finish.
  • Customized care plan: Based on your exam, we’ll create a simple, personalized routine to support your oral and whole-body health.
